fields.label: Make-up sessions behavior
options: Set transfered make-up sessions — At the end of the class, make-up sessions up to your setting will be transferred and new expiration date will be set for them. This way your clients will still be able to use their make-up sessions in the next period/programme but only up to the limit you choose.
All make-up sessions expire at the end of the class. — The day the class ends, all valid make-up sessions will expire and be voided.
All make-up sessions expire after the preset number of days — The end of the class won’t affect make-up sessions at all. They will naturally expire when their date comes.

fields.label: Maximum number of transferred make-up session between billing periods.
fields.help: Enter the number of make-up sessions that the client can use in the next billing period. This number will only start to be deducted after the class has finished. If you leave a value of 0, it will mean that the function is disabled.

fields.label: Number of days to use transferred make-up sessions
fields.help: The number of days after the end of the class until which it is possible to use transferred make-up sessions — sessions not used in the previous billing period.

fields.label: Default expiration of credits (in days)
fields.help: The specified number of days applies to all types of credits (especially make-up session). The value will start to be deducted from the date the entitlement is created.

fields.label: Additional slots in classes
fields.help: Additional slots in classes intended only for make-up sessions.

intro: Allow or request to share make-up sessions with partner company in Zooza.
